commits.message:
Replace default route with Scaffold

Updated the default route in onGenerateRoute to return a Scaffold instead of SplashView to handle undefined routes more gracefully.

Add `getUser` function and update `CustomHomeAppbar` to display user name

- Introduced a new helper function `getUser` in `get_user.dart` to retrieve user data from shared preferences.
- Updated `AuthRepoImpl` to save user data after successful sign-in.
- Modified `CustomHomeAppbar` to dynamically display the user's name using the `getUser` function.

Add user data endpoint and save user data functionality

- Added a new endpoint `kUser` in `BackEndEndpoints` for user data.
- Added factory constructor `fromUserEntity` and `toMap` method in `UserModel`.
- Imported `dart:convert` and `SharedPreferencesSingleton` in `AuthRepoImpl`.
- Updated `signInWithGoogle` method to save user data if the user does not exist.
- Added `saveUserData` method in `AuthRepoImpl` to save user data to shared preferences.
- Removed `toMap` method from `UserEntity`.
- Added `saveUserData` method in `AuthRepo` abstract class.

Add `isSignedIn` method and update splash navigation logic

Added an `isSignedIn` method to `FirebaseAuthService` to check if a user is signed in. Updated the `excuteNavigation` method in `SplashViewBody` to navigate to the home screen if the user is signed in, otherwise navigate to the sign-in screen. Ensured that the context is checked for being mounted before performing navigation.

Add notification widget to app bars

Added a new `NotificationWidget` and integrated it into the `CustomAppBar` and `CustomHomeAppbar`. Also, updated the `BestSellingView` to use the `buildAppBar` function with a title.

Add BestSellingView and update BestSellerHead to navigate to it

Added a new `BestSellingView` and its corresponding body widget. Updated `BestSellerHead` to navigate to `BestSellingView` when tapped.

Refactor navigation bar items for better layout and interaction

Updated the `ActiveItem` and `InactiveItem` widgets to remove unnecessary `Expanded` widgets and adjusted the `CustomNavigationBar` to handle item selection and flex properties more effectively. This change ensures that the active navigation bar item is visually distinct and interactive.

Enhance Navigation Bar with Active and Inactive States

Updated the `ActiveItem` widget to include a text label and a styled container. Modified the `CustomNavigationBar` to manage the selected index state and pass it to `NavigationBarItem`. Adjusted the `NavigationBarItem` to use the `isSelected` flag and updated the `InActiveItem` to use flex properties for better layout management.

Refactor navigation bar and remove hardcoded dimensions

- Removed hardcoded width and height from `FruitItem`.
- Created new `ActiveNavItem` and `InactiveNavItem` widgets.
- Refactored `CustomNavigationBar` to use `NavigationBarItem` and `bottomNavItems`.
- Moved `NavigationBarItem` to its own file.
- Updated imports and removed unused code.

Add BottomNavBarEntity and update custom_navigation_bar

Introduce a new entity `ButtomNavBarEntity` to represent navigation bar items and update `custom_navigation_bar.dart` to include active and inactive item widgets.

Add Vuesax SVG icons and update navigation bar

Added Vuesax bold and outline SVG icons for home, product, shopping cart, and user. Updated the `CustomNavigationBar` to use these icons and adjusted the background color. Also, included the new icons in the `pubspec.yaml` file.

Refactor and add new widgets for home view

- Reorganized and refactored the `FruitItem` widget for better readability.
- Added `BestSellingGridView` to display best-selling items in a grid format.
- Added `CustomNavigationBar` for the home view's bottom navigation.
- Updated `HomeView` to include the new `CustomNavigationBar`.
- Updated `HomeViewBody` to include `BestSellingGridView` and removed redundant `FruitItem`.

Make `CircleAvatar` and `Icon` widgets constant in `FruitItem`

Ensure that the `CircleAvatar` and `Icon` widgets in the `FruitItem` class are marked as constant to improve performance and reduce unnecessary rebuilds.

Add FruitItem widget and update HomeViewBody

Added a new `FruitItem` widget in the core widgets directory and updated the `HomeViewBody` to include this new widget. The `FruitItem` widget displays a fruit item with an image, name, price, and an add button. The `HomeViewBody` now includes a `FruitItem` widget below the best seller header.

Add BestSellerHead widget and integrate it into HomeViewBody

Created a new `BestSellerHead` widget to display the "الأكثر مبيعًا" (Best Sellers) header with a "المزيد" (More) link. Integrated this widget into the `HomeViewBody` by adding it below the `FeaturedList` with appropriate spacing.

Refactor and add `FeaturedList` widget

Refactored `FeaturedItem` widget to improve layout and added a new `FeaturedList` widget to display multiple featured items horizontally in the `HomeViewBody`.

Update FeaturedItem to use SvgPicture and fix formatting issues

Updated the FeaturedItem widget to use SvgPicture for SVG images and fixed some formatting issues, including adding missing commas and adjusting the image positioning.

Add featured item widget and background assets

Added a new `FeaturedItem` widget along with its button component and integrated it into the `HomeViewBody`. Also, included new SVG and PNG assets for the featured item background and test image. Updated `pubspec.yaml` and `pubspec.lock` to include the `flutter_svg_provider` dependency.

Add new images and home view components

Added new SVG images for filter, notification, and search icon, as well as a PNG image for the profile. Introduced a new `HomeView` and its associated widgets, including `CustomHomeAppbar` and `HomeViewBody`. Updated route generation to include the new `HomeView` and added a search text field widget. Also, modified the sign-in and sign-up view body bloc consumers to handle navigation and error messages appropriately.

Add documentId parameter to addData and implement checkDataExist method

Updated the `DataBaseServices` abstract class to include an optional `documentId` parameter in the `addData` method and added a new method `checkDataExist` to check if a document exists. Modified `FireStoreServices` to handle the new `documentId` parameter in `addData` and implemented the `checkDataExist` method. Updated `BackEndEndpoints` to include new endpoints for user data retrieval and existence check. Modified `AuthRepoImpl` to use the new `getUseData` method and check if a user exists before adding user data. Updated `AuthRepo` to include the new `getUseData` method.

Update `DataBaseServices` and `FireStoreServices` to return `Map<String, dynamic>` instead of `UserEntity`

Refactor the `getUserData` method in `DataBaseServices` and its implementation in `FireStoreServices` to return a `Map<String, dynamic>` instead of a `UserEntity`. This change allows for more flexibility in handling data retrieved from the database.

Add platform-specific social login button for iOS

Added a conditional check to display the Apple login button only on iOS devices. This ensures that the Apple login option is only available when the app is running on an iOS platform.

Add GoogleService-Info.plist and update FirebaseAuthService error handling

Added the GoogleService-Info.plist file for iOS configuration and updated the FirebaseAuthService to handle the 'invalid-credential' error by throwing a CustomException with an appropriate message.

Add Facebook Login Integration

Implemented Facebook login functionality across the Android and Flutter app. This includes adding the necessary dependencies, updating the AndroidManifest.xml, and creating the required strings in strings.xml. Additionally, updated the FirebaseAuthService, AuthRepoImpl, SigninCubit, and SignInViewBody to support Facebook authentication. Also, made necessary changes in the generated plugin registrants for Linux, macOS, and Windows to include the FlutterSecureStorage plugin.

Add Google Sign-In functionality and Gradle setup for fruits-app

- Added Google Sign-In functionality to `FirebaseAuthService`, `AuthRepoImpl`, `AuthRepo`, `SigninCubit`, and `SignInViewBody`.
- Updated `pubspec.yaml` and `pubspec.lock` to include `google_sign_in` and related dependencies.
- Added Gradle setup for the `fruits-app` including `build.gradle`, `settings.gradle`, and Gradle wrapper files.
- Added `.gitattributes` and `.gitignore` for the `fruits-app` to manage line endings and ignore build artifacts.
- Added `devtools_options.yaml` to store settings for Dart & Flutter DevTools.

Update app icons and add custom progress HUD and BLoC consumer for sign-in view

Updated app icons across different resolutions for both Android and iOS platforms. Added a new `CustomProgressHud` widget to handle loading states using `modal_progress_hud_nsn`. Refactored `SigninView` to use `SigninViewBodyBlocConsumer` which integrates `BlocConsumer` for state management, and updated `SigninViewBody` to handle form validation and state management more effectively.

Refactor authentication views and cubits

Renamed `LoginView` to `SigninView` and updated all references accordingly. Created new `SigninCubit` and `SignupCubit` for handling authentication logic. Updated `AuthRepo` and `AuthRepoImpl` to remove the `name` parameter from `signInWithEmailAndPassword`. Added new state classes for `SigninCubit` and `SignupCubit`.

Add sign in with email and password functionality

Implemented the `signInWithEmailAndPassword` method in `FirebaseAuthService` to handle user sign-in. Also, updated `AuthRepoImpl` and `AuthRepo` to include the new method, ensuring proper error handling and logging.

Add logging and handle additional FirebaseAuthException cases

Enhanced error handling in FirebaseAuthService by adding logging for exceptions and handling additional cases such as 'invalid-email' and 'network-request-failed'. Also added logging in AuthRepoImpl for better debugging.

Add terms acceptance check in sign-up process

Updated the sign-up view to include a check for terms and conditions acceptance. Added a boolean state variable `isTermsAccepted` and updated the `TermsAndConditionsWidget` to toggle this variable. Modified the sign-up button's onPressed method to verify if the terms are accepted before proceeding with user creation. If not accepted, a snackbar is shown to prompt the user.

Add PasswordField widget and update SignUpViewBody

Created a new `PasswordField` widget that encapsulates the password input field with toggle visibility functionality. Updated `SignUpViewBody` to use the new `PasswordField` widget instead of the inline `CustomTextFormField` for password input.

Add error message helper and custom Bloc observer

- Introduced `buildErrorMessage` function to handle error messages consistently.
- Created `CustomBlocObserver` to log Bloc transitions and changes in debug mode.
- Updated `SignUpViewBodyBlocConsumer` to use `buildErrorMessage` for displaying error messages.
- Configured `CustomBlocObserver` in `main.dart` to monitor Bloc events globally.

Update sign-up view and error messages

- Updated error messages to Arabic.
- Converted `SignUpViewBody` to a `StatefulWidget` to handle form validation and state.
- Added `ModalProgressHUD` to show loading indicator during sign-up.
- Updated `SignUpViewBodyBlocConsumer` to handle success and failure states and show appropriate messages.
- Added `modal_progress_hud_nsn` dependency for the loading indicator.

Set minimum SDK version to 23

Updated the minimum SDK version in the build.gradle file to 23 to ensure compatibility with a wider range of Android devices. This change aligns with the project's requirements and helps in maintaining consistent behavior across different Android versions.

Refactor and add service locator for dependency injection

- Renamed `FireBaseAuthService` to `FirebaseAuthService` for consistency.
- Added `service_locator.dart` to manage dependencies using GetIt.
- Updated `AuthRepoImpl` to use `FirebaseAuthService`.
- Refactored `SignUpView` to use `BlocProvider` and `SignUpViewBodyBlocConsumer`.
- Added `SignUpViewBodyBlocConsumer` to handle state management with Bloc.
- Initialized dependencies in `main.dart` using `setupDependencies`.

Add SignupCubit and SignupState for user registration

Implemented the SignupCubit and SignupState classes to handle user registration logic using the BLoC pattern. Added necessary dependencies such as `flutter_bloc` and `get_it` to the `pubspec.yaml` and `pubspec.lock` files.

Add UserModel and update AuthRepoImpl for user creation

Implemented UserModel to map Firebase User to UserEntity. Updated AuthRepoImpl to include createUserWithEmailAndPassword method, which creates a user with email, password, and name, and handles exceptions. Modified UserEntity to include name and remove password. Updated AuthRepo interface to reflect the new method signature.

Add custom exceptions, failures, and Firebase authentication service

Implemented custom exception and failure classes for better error handling. Added Firebase authentication service for user registration and updated the authentication repository to use these new classes. Also, registered the Firebase Auth plugin for macOS and Windows platforms.

Add UserEntity and AuthRepo for authentication domain

Introduce UserEntity to represent user data and AuthRepo to define the authentication repository interface, including a method for signing in with email and password.

Configure Firebase for Android and update application settings

Added Firebase configuration to the Android project, including the `google-services.json` file and necessary Gradle plugins. Updated the application namespace, application ID, and package name to `com.yourdomain.fruitshub`. Also, initialized Firebase in the `main.dart` file and created `firebase_options.dart` to manage Firebase options for different platforms.

Add Firebase Core Plugin

Integrate Firebase Core plugin for macOS and Windows platforms. This includes updating the `GeneratedPluginRegistrant.swift` for macOS and `generated_plugin_registrant.cc` and `generated_plugins.cmake` for Windows. Additionally, update `pubspec.yaml` and `pubspec.lock` to include the Firebase Core dependency.

Add new assets and widgets for sign-up and terms and conditions

- Added `.vscode/easycode.ignore` to specify files and directories to ignore.
- Added `Check.svg` to the assets/images directory.
- Updated `app_images.dart` to include the new `Check.svg` asset.
- Created `CustomCheckBox` widget for handling check box functionality.
- Created `HaveAnAccountWidget` for the "Have an account?" text with a login link.
- Updated `SignUpViewBody` to include form fields, terms and conditions, and sign-up button.
- Created `TermsAndConditionsWidget` to handle terms and conditions checkbox and text.

Add SignUpView and update AppBar to accept dynamic titles

- Added `SignUpView` with its route and basic structure.
- Updated `buildAppBar` to accept a dynamic title parameter.
- Modified `LoginView` to use the updated `buildAppBar` with the title 'تسجيل دخول'.
- Updated `DontHaveAnAccountWidget` to navigate to `SignUpView` when tapped.
- Added `SignUpViewBody` with a placeholder for future implementation.

Update social login button titles and add spacing

Updated the titles of the social login buttons to specify the platform (Google, Apple, Facebook) and added spacing between the buttons for better UI layout.

Add new SVG icons and update login view

Added new SVG icons for Apple, Facebook, and Google, and an onboarding background image. Updated the login view to include these icons and new UI components such as `CustomTextFormField`, `DontHaveAnAccountWidget`, `OrDivider`, and `SocialLoginButton`.

Add custom app bar and login view body

Implemented a custom app bar for the login screen and created a new widget for the login view body. Updated the main theme to include a white scaffold background and a primary color scheme.

Add SharedPreferences Singleton and Onboarding Completion Tracking

Introduce a SharedPreferences singleton for managing shared preferences across the app. Update the onboarding flow to track whether the onboarding has been seen, and navigate accordingly from the splash screen. Adjust the onboarding view and page view items to set the onboarding completion status when the user skips or finishes the onboarding. Ensure the main function initializes the SharedPreferences instance. Update dependencies and lock file to include the shared_preferences package and its related dependencies.

Add OnBoardingView and update SplashView

- Added `OnBoardingView` and updated `onGenerateRoute` to include the new route.
- Created `app_images.dart` to manage image assets.
- Refactored `SplashView` to use `SplashViewBody` for better separation of concerns.
- Added `flutter_svg` dependency for SVG image support.
- Updated `pubspec.yaml` and `pubspec.lock` with new dependencies and asset configurations.

Add onGenerateRoute for route management

Implemented onGenerateRoute function to handle routing in the application. Added a static routeName to SplashView and configured MaterialApp to use onGenerateRoute and initialRoute.

Add initial Flutter project structure and macOS/Windows configurations

This commit initializes the basic structure for a Flutter project, including macOS and Windows configurations. It adds necessary files such as `pubspec.yaml`, `pubspec.lock`, and various configuration files for macOS and Windows builds. The commit also includes initial setup for macOS Runner, entitlements, and test files, as well as the basic structure for Windows builds using CMake.

Add custom exceptions, failures, and repository interfaces

Introduce `CustomException` and `Failures` classes for error handling, and define abstract repository interfaces `ImageRepo` and `ProductRepo` along with their implementations. Also, add the `dartz` package to manage `Either` types for error handling.

Remove unnecessary newline in setState block

This commit removes an unnecessary newline within the setState block to maintain clean and consistent code formatting.

Add `AddProductInputEntity` and update `AddProductViewBody` with form validation and submission

- Introduced `AddProductInputEntity` to encapsulate product input data.
- Updated `AddProductViewBody` to include form validation, state management, and submission logic.
- Added `IsFeaturedChecked` widget for handling the featured status of the product.
- Removed unused imports and widgets.
- Implemented form field saving and validation logic.
- Added a `CustomButton` for submitting the form and handling image selection validation.

Add `AddProductInputEntity` and update `AddProductViewBody` with form validation and submission

- Introduced `AddProductInputEntity` to encapsulate product input data.
- Updated `AddProductViewBody` to include form validation, state management, and submission logic.
- Added `IsFeaturedChecked` widget for

Add CustomCheckBox and IsFeaturedChecked widget

Implemented a `CustomCheckBox` widget for a customizable checkbox with animation and integrated it into the `AddProductViewBody` through the `IsFeaturedChecked` widget. This allows users to toggle the "Is Featured" option when adding a product.

Make `onValueChanged` parameter required in `ImageField`

Ensure that the `onValueChanged` parameter in the `ImageField` widget is required to prevent potential null issues and improve the robustness of the widget.

Add image upload functionality and update dependencies

- Added `ImageField` widget to allow users to upload images.
- Updated `Info.plist` to include `NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` for iOS.
- Added necessary plugins and dependencies for image selection and file handling across different platforms.
- Updated `pubspec.yaml` and `pubspec.lock` to include new dependencies such as `image_picker`, `skeletonizer`, and `file_selector` for various platforms.
- Modified `AddProductViewBody` to include the `ImageField` widget for image uploads.

Add ImageField widget to AddProductViewBody

Added a new `ImageField` widget to the `AddProductViewBody` to allow users to select or display an image for the product being added. The `ImageField` widget is a simple container with a grey border and an outlined image icon.

Add custom AppBar and TextFormField widgets

Created `CustomAppBar` and `CustomTextFormField` widgets in the core widgets directory. Updated `AddProductView` to use `CustomAppBar` and wrapped `AddProductViewBody` in a `SafeArea`. Modified `AddProductViewBody` to include multiple `CustomTextFormField` widgets for product details.

Add AddProductView and update routing and UI components

- Added `AddProductView` and its associated body widget.
- Updated `onGenerateRoute` to include the new `AddProductView`.
- Created `CustomButton` widget in core widgets.
- Updated `DashboardViewBody` to navigate to `AddProductView` using `CustomButton`.
- Disabled debug banner in `MainApp`.

Add macOS and Windows project structure and initial files for Flutter app

This commit adds the necessary project structure and initial files for building a Flutter application on macOS and Windows. It includes:

- macOS project files such as `Info.plist`, `AppIcon.appiconset`, and `MainFlutterWindow.swift`.
- Windows project files including `CMakeLists.txt`, `flutter_window.cpp`, and `main.cpp`.
- Configuration files like `AppInfo.xcconfig`, `Debug.xcconfig`, and `Release.xcconfig` for macOS.
- Entitlements files for both macOS and Windows.
- Initial test files for macOS and Windows.
- `pubspec.yaml` and `pubspec.lock` for managing Flutter dependencies.
- Web assets and configuration files for serving the app on the web.

These additions set up the basic environment for developing and running a Flutter application across multiple platforms.
